dense_phase.event_classification_rule: If equal shell profiles first appear, report whether the colliding topologies nevertheless have identical one-leaf child topology sets. Distinguish topology-invariant failure from continuation-quotient failure.
dense_phase.event_stop_rule: Stop dense maturation immediately at the first topology-separation or continuation-sufficiency failure of SHELL_PROFILE_MULTISET.
dense_phase.generator: Continue the certified R1 unlabeled-tree census rank-by-rank by all one-leaf attachments with AHU canonical deduplication; do not rematerialize exact G3 relation frontiers.
dense_phase.memory_rule: Keep only the current and next unlabeled-tree ranks plus compact shell-profile keys; do not retain the full R1-style all-rank topology table.
dense_phase.plateau_rule: If ranks through at least 17 complete with no selected-read event and the last 4 dense ranks retain the same no-break grammar/read signature, declare a local dense plateau and proceed to sparse sentinels. Rank 18 is a hard reserve rank only if the plateau rule has not yet fired.
dense_phase.selected_read_continuation_gate: Within each exhaustively enumerated parent rank, equal SHELL_PROFILE_MULTISET must imply the same set of unlabeled child topologies under all one-leaf attachments.
dense_phase.selected_read_topology_gate: Within each exhaustively enumerated rank, equal SHELL_PROFILE_MULTISET must imply equal unlabeled tree canonical form.

gates.authority: Certified R1 primary result and exact cold replay comparison must pass; G3 graduation preserved; G4 unstarted.
gates.no_promotion: R2 cannot promote shell profiles/topology into G3 state and cannot launch G4.
gates.r1_prefix: The dense seed rank n=12 must exactly reproduce the 551 certified R1 topology canons and selected shell-profile values before extension.
gates.science_stop: A selected-read break is a scientific event/PASS classification, not an operational failure; only authority/integrity mismatches fail closed.

question: After certified G3:R1, does the hidden one-cross tree-grafting grammar or the selected SHELL_PROFILE_MULTISET challenge read exhibit a delayed break under adaptive post-graduation maturation, and if not, is there enough dense-plus-sparse evidence to declare a local reconnaissance plateau before G4 Phase 0?

sparse_sentinels.event_classification_rule: If a sentinel shell-profile collision appears, distinguish topology-only collision from one-step continuation collision.
sparse_sentinels.family: Deterministic adversarial tree family per sentinel: path, star, all double-stars, bounded brooms, all unordered 3-arm spiders, bounded deterministic 4-arm spiders, and 256 fixed-seed Prüfer trees; canonical-deduplicate before audit.
sparse_sentinels.gate: Search the frozen sentinel family for nonisomorphic equal-SHELL_PROFILE_MULTISET trees; if found, compare their full one-leaf child topology sets and report a sentinel event. Absence is sentinel support only, never exhaustive proof at that rank.
sparse_sentinels.parallelization: Independent sentinel ranks are decomposable and must execute through the Decoder execution backend.
sparse_sentinels.seed_rule: SHA256("IG_G3_R2_SENTINEL_V1|n|sample_index") interpreted deterministically; no adaptive reseeding from outcomes.
